POS Auto Invoice Check

The POS Auto Invoice Check module enhances Odoo Point of Sale by automatically enabling the invoice option during order validation. This helps businesses that require invoices for every POS transaction, improving accuracy and reducing manual steps for cashiers.



  • Features
  • Screenshots
  • Support
  • Service

Features

Automatic Invoice Activation in POS

The module intelligently auto-checks the Invoice option every time a new POS order is created. This ensures that the cashier no longer needs to manually select the invoice checkbox for each sale, saving time during busy checkout hours.

Easy Configuration Through General Settings

With just one click, administrators can enable or disable automatic invoice generation without any technical steps or coding knowledge.

Screenshot

1.) POS Auto Invoice Configuration in Settings

This screen shows the configuration panel for the POS Auto Invoice Check module, located under Settings. Here, administrators can enable the Allow Auto Invoice True option, which activates automatic invoice generation for POS orders.


Navigation : Setting → INKERP → Allow Auto Invoice True


2.) Invoice Auto-Checked in POS Payment Screen

This screenshot displays the POS payment interface where the Invoice option is automatically checked due to the enabled module configuration. When a cashier processes an order, the system pre-selects invoice generation without requiring manual action.
